quests.title: Not to be Missed

dialogue.t: *sigh* Where has that kid Bennett run off to? I hope he didn't run into any trouble.

dialogue.sit: There are still monsters out and about...

dialogue.t: Monsters are still in the area, eh? So it seems that the effects of the Storm have yet to disperse...
Hahaha! So there's still time, then — time for the Adventurers' Guild to show its quality.
It is up to us to take those monsters out in the wild on, while the Knights of Favonius are still focused on defending the city and the area around Mondstadt.
I understand. Thanks for your help in investigating. I will reconsider the commissions that we will be sending out. Take these as your reward.

quests.description: The storm has subsided, but Cyrus seems displeased…
